pages.text: FOR counts with a loop variable.$(br2)A name, a type (INTEGER or FLOAT), a start value and an end value follow. An optional third value is the step. Without it, the step is 1. The step may not be 0, and a negative step counts down.
The end value is included. The values are computed once, before the loop starts. You can't change the loop variable yourself.
Craft a structural base and a dirt block, or turn an EACH block into a FOR block.
$(1)FOR i INTEGER 1 ; 10 ; 2 ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN sum sum + i ;$(br)END FOR$()
The loop runs with i = 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9.
